criteria.criterion: Use Microsoft Careers to search for an Applied Scientist role in/associated with Redmond, WA (or clearly report access blockers)
criteria.final_justification: Visual evidence confirms the agent performed (or at minimum set up and executed) a targeted Microsoft Careers search for Applied Scientist roles associated with Redmond, WA. Baseline remains correct.

criteria.criterion: Open one relevant listing and stop after opening one (or report that no exact match exists)
criteria.final_justification: The screenshots clearly show a relevant Applied Scientist listing associated with Redmond opened in the job detail pane. While screenshots can’t prove the agent never opened another listing earlier, there is no evidence of multiple listings being opened, and the requirement is satisfied in the observable session state. Keep full credit.

criteria.criterion: Report the job number from the listing (or state it is not shown)
criteria.final_justification: The agent’s reported job number (200017828) matches the job number visible in screenshot 5. Baseline score should be raised to full credit.

criteria.criterion: Report the work-site arrangement from the listing (or state it is not shown)
criteria.final_justification: The agent’s reported work-site arrangement matches the listing’s displayed “Work site” field in screenshot 5. Baseline should be raised to full credit.

criteria.criterion: Report two key responsibilities from the listing
criteria.final_justification: The agent output’s two responsibilities do not match the responsibilities visible in screenshot 6 (they appear generalized/unsupported vs. the specific bullets shown). Because the reported responsibilities are contradicted by the screenshot evidence, this remains a critical accuracy failure for this criterion.

criteria.criterion: Report two preferred qualifications from the listing (or clearly state preferred qualifications are not listed)
criteria.final_justification: The agent reported two preferred qualifications that are supported by screenshot 7: (1) rich ML experience in NLP/deep learning; and (2) experience with language model training/evaluation (and it also mentioned Responsible AI research, which is another separate preferred bullet). Even though the agent combined two bullets in one line, it still provided at least two valid preferred qualifications from the listing. Award full credit.

criteria.criterion: Respect constraints (no sign-in, no application, no form submission)
criteria.final_justification: No evidence of signing in, applying, or submitting any form; behavior shown is consistent with simple browsing. Keep full credit.
